info.title: Flow App Universal API
info.description: Webinar platform for managing Flow events, registrants, operators, surveys, and event reports via the official Flow REST API.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

published.description: Whether to publish the event immediately or save it as a draft.

creatorId.description: The numeric ID of the event creator.

description.description: The event description shown on registration and access pages.

date.description: The event date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

time.description: The event time in 24-hour HH:MI:SS format.

operators[].description: Array of operator objects participating in the event.

operators[].id.description: Operator ID in the operators array.

operators[].role.description: Operator role where 5 is presenter and 10 is organizer.

operators[].micEnabled.description: Whether the operator microphone is enabled.

operators[].camEnabled.description: Whether the operator camera is enabled.

operators[].screenSharingEnabled.description: Whether screen sharing is enabled for the operator.

earlyAccessPeriod.description: Minutes before the event when attendees can begin logging in.

videoRecord.description: Whether the event should be recorded.

onDemandReplays.description: Whether attendees can register to view replays after the event ends.

code.description: Provider-level Flow response code returned by the create event endpoint.

localDescription.description: Provider error description returned by Flow when event creation is rejected.

message.description: Provider response message returned by the create event endpoint.
